name: The Coworking Space of Eternal Silence
flavor_text: A white-walled productivity temple where even coughing feels like a felony.
mechanical_hooks: Loud actions trigger a CHA save DC 15 or take 1d6 psychic damage from collective judgment. On a scene hazard roll of 1, WiFi fails and all tech checks risk Panic.
quest_hooks: Find the last functioning outlet; recover the WiFi password; survive a networking event you never agreed to attend.

name: The Overpriced Avocado Toast Cafe
flavor_text: The menu is on a QR code that loads only after you have emotionally detached from brunch.
mechanical_hooks: Waiting more than one scene beat forces a CON save DC 12 or gain Exhaustion 1. The bill forces a WIS save DC 14 or you overtip out of shame.
quest_hooks: Steal a table with an outlet; decode the WiFi password hidden in the decor; survive passive-aggressive latte hierarchy.

name: Zhongshan Rooftop Bars
flavor_text: The skyline is gorgeous, the cocktails are ruinous, and everybody here is performing sincerity in increasingly expensive shoes.
mechanical_hooks: Sonic attacks gain +1 damage. Any failed flirt roll can raise Heat by 1 if the scene is public enough.
quest_hooks: Find a catfish, dodge a clinger, or turn a Hard Pass into a lead on something bigger.
